easycrosshair.options.title: Easy Crosshair
easycrosshair.options.enabled.tooltip: Replace Minecraft's crosshair with your own. Turn off to get the vanilla crosshair back.
easycrosshair.options.shape.tooltip: The crosshair design. Click to cycle through the shapes.
easycrosshair.options.editing.tooltip: Which color the sliders below change. Hostile, Passive and Player are used while you aim at those mobs.
easycrosshair.options.color_mode.tooltip: Rainbow cycles the crosshair through every color. It keeps the opacity but ignores Red, Green and Blue.
easycrosshair.options.color.tooltip: Changes the color picked with the Color button.
easycrosshair.options.alpha.tooltip: Transparency of the color picked with the Color button. 255 is fully opaque.
easycrosshair.options.length.tooltip: How long the lines are. For Circle and Square it sets the size together with Gap.
easycrosshair.options.gap.tooltip: Empty space between the center and the lines.
easycrosshair.options.thickness.tooltip: How thick the lines and the dot are.
easycrosshair.options.outline.tooltip: A dark border that keeps the crosshair visible on bright backgrounds. 0 turns it off.
easycrosshair.options.target_colors.tool: Change color while aiming at a mob: Hostile, Passive or Player.
easycrosshair.options.attack_indicator.t: Bar shows a charge bar under the crosshair, Fade dims the crosshair until your attack is ready. Both pulse when it is ready. Vanilla keeps Minecraft's own indicator.
easycrosshair.options.dynamic_spread.too: The crosshair opens up while you move, sprint or jump, and closes in while you draw a bow or crossbow.
